mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level 0.07%) compresses discount rates in equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns as monetary policy remains accommodative.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.07% is historically low
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) indicate real economy contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as recession risks intensify.
evidence_refs: fact:Current INDPRO and PAYEMS show negative 3-month changes
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO 3-month change < -0.5% and PAYEMS 3-month change < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%) triggers monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as equity discount rates increase.
evidence_refs: fact:Current CPIAUCSL YoY inflation is 2.5% below 3.0% threshold
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units signal weak consumer demand and housing market contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as recession fears rise.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A high retail sales level (RSAFS > 600,000 million) indicates robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as corporate earnings are supported by strong demand.
evidence_refs: fact:Current RSAFS at 603,581 million exceeds 600,000 threshold
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 600,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruption, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as recession risks increase.
evidence_refs: fact:Current INDPRO at 98.3856 is below 100 threshold
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings strengthen.
evidence_refs: fact:Current GDPC1 and INDPRO growth rates are positive
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 3-month growth > 1.5% and INDPRO 3-month growth > 0.5%.
